resources.string: Tick or untick several contacts at once to add them to, or remove them from, Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers\" list. Changes are applied the next time that screen opens. Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers\" switch must be on for them to be recorded.
Waiting: %1$d to add, %2$d to remove. Open Phone → Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers.
Google Phone\'s \"Selected numbers → Add\" opens this module\'s multi-select list instead of the one-contact picker. Restart Google Phone after changing.
Contacts permission is needed to list your phone numbers.
Ready: %1$d to add, %2$d to remove. In Phone, open Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers to apply.
Couldn\'t open Google Phone. Open Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers in Phone to apply the changes.
Numbers already on Google Phone\'s list are shown after you open Phone → Settings → Call recording → Selected numbers once.
